mapper.sql: u.id, u.real_name AS name, u.title, u.hospital, u.department, pr.specialty, pr.introduction, pr.max_patients, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient pt WHERE pt.doctor_id = u.id AND pt.deleted = 0) AS patient_count

SELECT
FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN doctor_profile pr ON pr.user_id = u.id AND pr.deleted = 0 WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role x INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = x.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE x.user_id = u.id AND r.role_key = 'DOCTOR') ORDER BY u.id

SELECT
FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN doctor_profile pr ON pr.user_id = u.id AND pr.deleted = 0 WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 AND u.id = #{doctorId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role x INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = x.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE x.user_id = u.id AND r.role_key = 'DOCTOR')
